name: Cosmic Ghost Rider

abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Aptitude: Fury, Armor Up ve Precision etkilerinin gücünü artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Fateseal: Uygulandığında hedefteki tüm buff'ları Nullify eder ve aktifken yenilerinin kazanılmasını engeller.

signatureAbility:
Cosmic Vengeance
The Powerlock Debuff triggered when reaching 5 Judgments is upgraded to a Damnation Debuff dealing [2,081.31 - 4,911.4] damage over 6 seconds. Opponents under Damnation are also Power Locked, Heal Blocked, and Fatesealed, all of which are unaffected by Ability Accuracy modifications.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: A lack of blood provides full immunity to Bleeding.
Being wreathed in Hellfire provides full Immunity to Incinerate

When fighting a #Villain, at the start of the fight gain a 100% Chance to place an indefinite Armor Break Debuff on the Opponent reducing their Armor Rating by [750], and removing an active Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Judgments - Passive
content: When Cosmic Ghost Rider triggers Armor Up, Fury, Precision, Cruelty, Power Gain, Unblockable, Vigilance, or Aptitude Buffs he also has a 100% chance to place a corresponding Judgment on his Opponent.
Each Judgment can only be stacked a single time, but lasts indefinitely.
Each Judgment placed on the Opponent increases the duration of any Buff Triggered on Cosmic Ghost Rider by 20%. While you have 5 Judgments in place, this bonus is doubled.
Upon gaining any 5 or more Judgments there is a 100% chance to place a Power Lock Debuff on the Opponent for 6 seconds.

After this Power Lock ends or if it fails to apply, all Judgments on the Opponent have a 100% chance to be converted into Armor Break Debuffs, each reducing Armor Rating by [562.5] for 10 seconds, and removing an Armor Up Buff.
If Cosmic Ghost Rider gains a Fateseal Debuff, he Removes all of his Judgments, and he cannot trigger new ones until it ends.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: When Struck if the Judgment of Armor is not active: 100% Chance to trigger an Armor Up Buff granting +[964.29] Armor for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Finish a 5 Hit Combo with a Medium Attack
content: If the Judgment of Vigilance is not active: 100% Chance to trigger a Vigilance Buff, preventing your attacks from Missing for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Finish a 5 Hit Combo with a Light Attack
content: If the Judgment of Power Gain is not active: 100% Chance to trigger a Power Gain Buff, granting 75% of a Bar of Power over 1.25 seconds.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: If the Judgment of Aptitude is not active, he has a 100% Chance to trigger an Aptitude Buff increasing the potency of any Armor Up, Fury, Cruelty, and Precision Buffs triggered by 50% for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If the Judgment of Cruelty is not active: 100% Chance to trigger a Cruelty Buff, increasing Critical Damage Rating by [790.54] for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On Activation if the Judgment of Unblockable is not active: 100% Chance to trigger an Unblockable Buff for 1 seconds.
This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [2,356.2] Energy Damage over 5 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On Activation if the Judgment of Precision Is not active: 100% Chance to trigger an Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by [9,000] for 10 seconds.
100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [1,840.91] for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: On Activation if the Judgment of Fury is not active: 100% Chance to trigger an Fury Buff increasing Attack by [4,908.75] for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Cosmic Vengeance
content: The Powerlock Debuff triggered when reaching 5 Judgments is upgraded to a Damnation Debuff dealing [2,081.31 - 4,911.4] damage over 6 seconds. Opponents under Damnation are also Power Locked, Heal Blocked, and Fatesealed, all of which are unaffected by Ability Accuracy modifications.
